newsitem.title: JAPAN: NTT, NEC to conduct PHS cell phone trial in Hanoi.
newsitem.headline: NTT, NEC to conduct PHS cell phone trial in Hanoi.

text.p: Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp and NEC Corp said on Monday that they would launch a PHS cellular phone trial service in Hanoi this month in cooperation with Vietnam's Posts and Telecommunications Ministry.
The six-month trial will be conducted in an area of Hanoi picked by the ministry and will use 100 PHS handsets, the two firms said.
The Personal Handyphone System (PHS) is a Japan-developed cellular phone system that is cheaper than conventional portable phones.
The two firms have so far conducted such trials in five other places in Asia -- Hong Kong, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand and Singapore.
